scope: Exact finite CAR fixtures only. Uniform double-scaling degree bounds require the separate analytic tagged proof.

conventions.variance_rescaling: a 2k-endpoint pairing and its norm bound both multiply by w_N^k
conventions.tags: all TI,TJ cardinality <=2 for covariance; each endpoint restriction is intersected before comparing to its union in the base edge orientation
conventions.norm: operator norm on fixed occupation sectors; normalized traces also recorded
conventions.proof_of_psd: exact Fraction Schur complements with zero-pivot row test
conventions.sampling: none; all finite labels/pairings in stated configurations enumerated
